original_paper: TLAST: A Time-Lag Aware Spatial-Temporal Transformer for Traffic Flow Forecasting, IEEE T-ITS 2025
task: current-time full-state reconstruction from a 12-step partially observed sequence
task_zh: 使用连续60分钟部分观测交通状态，重建最后一个5分钟时间片的全量四状态。

kept_from_PEMS07_12_12: cosine warmup 5 epochs from 1e-6, lr_min=0, decay_rate=0.1, t_initial=epochs
hyperparameter_source.why_PEMS07: Released road-network configs use M=8. PEMS07 has 883 nodes, the closest published network below Xuancheng26's 1406. CA (8600 nodes) drops M to 2 and is not the matching scale. PEMS07 also uses n_heads=1.

adaptations.adaptation_reason: The label is the full state at the last history slot, not the next 12 slots. The shared hidden layer stays Linear(T*d, d_out)+GELU. Only one output head is used.
Xuancheng26 R graph has 1406 edges. Widths are unchanged. The node readout is still Linear(num_nodes, M).
One TLAST class. --input-type and --target-type select the prepared state NPZ files. Channel order is inflow, outflow, accumulation_start, accumulation_end.

adaptations.original_value: always add the newest input in the shared z-score space
adaptations.adaptation_reason: STID, STAEformer, Graph WaveNet, and STFGNN predict the full state directly and do not add the latest partial count. The original residual adds the newest z-scored input and inverts with that same scaler, which is head*std + latest_raw. Partial observations and full labels use different training statistics, so the optional path converts x_raw with the target scaler before adding it. All-to-single uses that target channel, not channel 0. The full label is never added. Encoder skip connections are unchanged. The default is false so the 63 runs optimize the same direct full-state target as the other baselines.

adaptations.original_value: one z-score fit on training history of the same series
adaptations.adapted_value: per-channel target scaler in state_normalization.json, fit on training days only
adaptations.adaptation_reason: Inputs stay normalized by the prepared per-rate input scaler. Loss and metrics invert predictions with the full-state target scaler. Validation and test statistics are not used.

adaptations.adapted_value: unmasked MAE, RMSE, MAPE_nonzero, WAPE on the raw scale
adaptations.adaptation_reason: Project zeros are real counts. MAPE_nonzero is the only zero filter, and it is applied after denormalization.
Prepared day_index is already Monday=0. Windows do not cross days. Embeddings still consume integer TOD and DOW, not raw lag numbers.
The shared DataLoader keeps the partial batch so every baseline sees 5540/1108/1385 windows.
